trajectory.patch:
The Kconfig warning indicates that `CONFIG_MAX_THREAD_BYTES` was set in `prj.conf` but its dependency `CONFIG_USERSPACE` was not met. `CONFIG_MAX_THREAD_BYTES` is specifically designed for userspace thread permission tracking. To resolve this inconsistency and ensure the `MAX_THREAD_BYTES` value is applied, `CONFIG_USERSPACE` must be explicitly enabled. This will allow the kernel to correctly configure its internal data structures for thread management, which might be the underlying cause of the "Load access fault" observed at runtime.

<tests/subsys/portability/cmsis_rtos_v2/prj.conf>
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
CONFIG_EVENTS=y
========
CONFIG_EVENTS=y
CONFIG_USERSPACE=y
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
